name: ∞-Topos Sheaf Condition Constraint Canonical
description: Encodes sheaf descent condition in ∞-topoi; verifies presheaves satisfy descent under covers

pytorch.reason: pytorch not needed; pure symbolic/algebraic computation via cvc5 and sympy

pyg.reason: PyG not needed; ∞-topos structure handled algebraically

z3.reason: z3 not needed; cvc5 handles all SMT constraint proofs

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed; homotopy theory via cvc5/sympy

geomstats.reason: geomstats not needed; ∞-categorical geometry handled symbolically

e3nn.reason: e3nn not needed; no SO(3) equivariance required

rustworkx.reason: rustworkx not needed; simplicial structure encoded in constraints

xgi.reason: xgi not needed; no hypergraph structure

toponetx.reason: toponetx not needed; standard algebraic computations sufficient

gudhi.reason: gudhi not needed; no persistent homology required

test_valid_sheaf.description: Valid sheaf with matching cover/equalizer counts should be SAT

test_constant_sheaf_contractible.description: Constant sheaf Z on contractible base has π_k = 0 for k ≥ 1

test_presheaf_fails_sheaf.description: Presheaf with cover but no equalizer cannot be sheaf (should be UNSAT)

test_noncontractible_fiber_unsat.description: ∞-sheaf over contractible base must have contractible fibers (Whitehead)

test_equalizer_exceeds_product.description: Equalizer count cannot exceed product of overlaps

test_yoneda_representable_sheaf.description: Representable presheaves satisfy sheaf condition by Yoneda

test_trivial_cover.description: Trivial cover (single element) always satisfies sheaf condition

test_empty_section_space.description: Empty cover fibers imply empty equalizer (degeneracy edge case)
